tr: "We'll call you on Friday morning."
de: Es heißt "We'll call you on Friday morning."

tr: İlan işin sabah sekizde başladığını söylüyor.
de: Die Anzeige sagt, dass die Arbeit morgens um acht beginnt.

tr: Programda pazar günü "09:00 Boat trip" yazıyor.
de: Im Programm steht für Sonntag "09:00 Boat trip".

tr: "The warranty is two years, so this isn't a problem."
de: Es heißt "The warranty is two years, so this isn't a problem."

tr: "We danced until two in the morning." Düğün Bursa'daydı.
de: "We danced until two in the morning." Die Hochzeit war in Bursa.

tr: "It's 60 euros a night, and the price includes breakfast."
de: Es heißt "It's 60 euros a night, and the price includes breakfast."

tr: "It's cheaper than the plane. The ticket is only 350 lira."
de: Es heißt "It's cheaper than the plane. The ticket is only 350 lira."

tr: "a big living room with a balcony" — balkon oturma odasında.
de: "a big living room with a balcony" — der Balkon gehört zum Wohnzimmer.

tr: "It's free, but the special version costs 3 dollars a month."
de: Es heißt "It's free, but the special version costs 3 dollars a month."

tr: "Everybody is giving four hundred lira." Hediye ortak alınıyor.
de: "Everybody is giving four hundred lira." Das Geschenk wird gemeinsam gekauft.

tr: "It will be slow until ten o'clock, so please use Green Street."
de: Es heißt "It will be slow until ten o'clock, so please use Green Street."

tr: "You should sleep at least eight hours" — şu an beş saat uyuyor.
de: "You should sleep at least eight hours" — zurzeit schläft sie fünf Stunden.

tr: "The flat is on the third floor of a quiet building." Asansör yok.
de: "The flat is on the third floor of a quiet building." Einen Aufzug gibt es nicht.

tr: "My father was a fisherman" — Elif yazları teknede ona yardım ederdi.
de: "My father was a fisherman" — Elif half ihm in den Sommern auf dem Boot.

tr: "You can bring an item back within 30 days." Elektronikte süre 14 gün.
de: "You can bring an item back within 30 days." Bei Elektronik sind es 14 Tage.

tr: "I have never written thirty pages in one week." Rapor henüz başlamadı.
de: "I have never written thirty pages in one week." Der Bericht hat noch nicht begonnen.

tr: "We have already received your deposit of £60." Toplam fiyat 240 pound.
de: "We have already received your deposit of £60." Der Gesamtpreis liegt bei 240 Pfund.

tr: "It's cold this morning, only four degrees" — yarın on iki derece olacak.
de: "It's cold this morning, only four degrees" — morgen werden es zwölf Grad.

tr: "I have already booked a room for you at the hotel." Mektubu Elif yazıyor.
de: "I have already booked a room for you at the hotel." Den Brief schreibt Elif.

tr: "We're going to stay there for three nights." Otelde değil, kuzenin evinde.
de: "We're going to stay there for three nights." Nicht im Hotel, sondern bei der Cousine.

tr: Kurdeleyi belediye başkanı kesti ve köprünün daha güvenli olduğunu söyledi.
de: Die Bürgermeisterin durchschnitt das Band und sagte, die Brücke sei sicherer.

tr: "I've already taken a food safety course." Büyük mutfak deneyimi yok ama kurs var.
de: "I've already taken a food safety course." Erfahrung in einer großen Küche fehlt, der Kurs aber nicht.

tr: "Is the black cable in the yellow port?" Kablo gri portta olduğu için bağlanmıyordu.
de: "Is the black cable in the yellow port?" Das Kabel steckte im grauen Anschluss, darum gab es keine Verbindung.
